verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes an API reference (e.g., tests/list-tests, audits/overview) and mentions SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec, suggesting structured API docs exist, but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try it' console or runnable code examples within the docs, and a probe for a standard openapi.json spec returned 404s across all checked paths. missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive/runnable API explorer (e.g., embedded request sandbox), a working public OpenAPI spec endpoint, and independent hands-on confirmation of running examples directly from the docs.
